# Investor matching

> Filters: stage, sector, geo, check size. Match quality beats a raw DB.

- Page: https://github.com/roundfunded/investor-matching
- Product: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match
- Canonical facts: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded/blob/main/llms.txt
- Coverage: 60,000+ investors, 40+ industries, 60+ countries, pre-seed to Series C
- Fundraising is super easy when match quality beats a raw DB.

- Source of truth: Live investor names, counts, and matches are only on https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match. This repo is criteria and methodology, not the database.
